Second Wind. Levna can use a bonus action on her turn to regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d10} + her level. Once she uses this feature, she can't use it again until she finishes a short or long rest.
3rd
Improved Critical. Levna's attack rolls now score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.
4th

Ability Score Improvement. Levna's Strength score increases by 2, raising the modifier by 1, so increase her {@skill Athletics} bonus by 1, and increase the bonuses to hit and damage of her weapon attacks by 1.
5th

Proficiency Bonus. Levna's proficiency bonus increases by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: the bonuses in the Saving Throws and Skills entries, her passive {@skill Perception} score, and the bonuses to hit of her weapon attacks.
6th
Extra Attack. Levna can attack twice, instead of once, whenever she takes the {@action Attack} action on her turn.
7th
Battle Readiness. Levna has advantage on initiative rolls.
8th

Ability Score Improvement. Levna's Strength score increases by 2, raising the modifier by 1, so increase her {@skill Athletics} bonus by 1, and increase the bonuses to hit and damage of her weapon attacks by 1.
9th

Proficiency Bonus. Levna's proficiency bonus increases by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: the bonuses in the Saving Throws and Skills entries, her passive {@skill Perception} score, and the bonuses to hit of her weapon attacks.
10th
Improved Defense. Levna's Armor Class increases by 1.
11th
Indomitable. Levna can reroll a saving throw that she fails, but she must use the new roll. Once she uses this feature, she can't use it again until she finishes a long rest.

rows: 2nd
Spellcasting. Tem learns another 1st-level spell: {@spell faerie fire}.
3rd
Spellcasting. Tem gains one 1st-level spell slot. She also learns another 1st-level spell: {@spell goodberry}.
4th

Ability Score Improvement. Tem's Wisdom score increases by 2, raising the modifier by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: her spell save DC and the bonus to hit of spell attacks; her Wisdom saving throw bonus; her {@skill Insight}, {@skill Medicine}, and {@skill Perception} bonuses; her passive {@skill Perception} score; and the DC of her Taunt action. Spellcasting. Tem learns another cantrip: {@spell mending}.
5th

Proficiency Bonus. Tem's proficiency bonus increases by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: her spell save DC and the bonus to hit of her spell attacks, the bonuses in the Saving Throws and Skills entries, and the bonuses to hit of her weapon attacks, and the DC of her Taunt action.
6th
Potent Cantrips. Tem adds her Wisdom modifier to the damage she deals with any cantrip.
7th
Spellcasting. Tem gains one 2nd-level spell slot. She also learns another 2nd-level spell: {@spell enhance ability}.
8th

Ability Score Improvement. Tem's Wisdom score increases by 2, raising the modifier by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: her spell save DC and the bonus to hit of spell attacks; her Wisdom saving throw bonus; her {@skill Insight}, {@skill Medicine}, and {@skill Perception} bonuses; her passive {@skill Perception} score; and the DC of her Taunt action.
9th

Proficiency Bonus. Tem's proficiency bonus increases by 1, so increase the following numbers by 1: her spell save DC and the bonus to hit of her spell attacks, the bonuses in the Saving Throws and Skills entries, the bonuses to hit of her weapon attacks, and the DC of her Taunt action.
10th
Spellcasting. Tem learns another cantrip: {@spell resistance}.
11th
Spellcasting. Tem gains one 3rd-level spell slot. She also learns another 3rd-level spell: {@spell dispel magic}.

en.caption: Reality Break Effects
rows: {@b Vision of the Far Realm.} The target takes {@damage 6d12} psychic damage, and it is {@condition stunned} until the end of the turn.
{@b Rending Rift.} The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d12} force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

{@b Wormhole.} The target is teleported, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see. The target also takes {@damage 10d12} force damage and is knocked {@condition prone}.
{@b Chill of the Dark Void.} The target takes {@damage 10d12} cold damage, and it is {@condition blinded} until the end of the turn.

Gazpacho—a cold soup served on hot days, made from pounded vegetables and fruit
{@recipe Honeyflame bread|HFLotT}—a fried dessert soaked in honey and coated in Marquesian spices
Fusaka fish—seafood cutlets smothered in Marquesian fusaka spice and fried in oil
Snakelocks noodles—sea anemone tendrils coated in honey batter and delicately fried
Queen's water—a soft drink made from syrup, honey, guava, and tamarind
Blacksand coffee—a tiny shot of coffee, brewed atop red-hot sand, Marquet-style

en.caption: Eiselcross Encounters: Levels 11–16
rows: An {@creature adult white dragon} confronts the characters, demanding treasure for passage through its territory. The dragon accepts 1,000 gp worth of treasure or a rare magic item as acceptable tribute.
The characters encounter an {@creature iron golem} that keeps walking in circles. The golem attacks any creatures within 10 feet of it but otherwise continues walking in circles.

The characters find a camp of {@dice 2d4} {@creature Minotaur||minotaurs} and {@dice 4d6} {@creature Orc||orcs} looking for wildfolk to recruit for the Kryn. These explorers want to keep their operation covert. If they aren't convinced the characters can keep their secret, the Xhorhasians attack.
A {@creature roc} flies overhead and attempts to scoop up a character of your choice as its next meal.

The characters encounter a coven of three {@creature Night Hag||night hags} searching for Aeorian items. In their humanoid guises, these hags pretend to be lost explorers and request the characters' escort. When the characters are in a vulnerable spot, the hags reveal their true nature and attack.
The characters are ambushed by {@dice 1d8 + 1} {@creature Frost Giant||frost giants}.
en.name: Eiselcross Encounters: Levels 11–16
